title: feat: Complete v3.0 roadmap — Phases 9, 10, 11
body:
Implements all remaining v3.0 roadmap items: DX tooling (Phase 9), performance/build optimization (Phase 10), and security/compliance hardening (Phase 11).

## Phase 9: Developer Experience & Tooling

- **JSON Schema `$id` URLs** — All 1,470 generated schemas now include `$id` (`https://schema.objectstack.io/v{version}/...`) and `x-spec-version`
- **Bundled schema** — `objectstack.json` with 1,452 `$defs` for IDE autocomplete
- **OpenAPI 3.1 generation** — New `build-openapi.ts` auto-generates spec from REST API protocol (CRUD, Metadata, Discovery endpoints)
- **`generate types` CLI** — New sub-command reads `objectstack.config.ts` objects and emits typed interfaces:
  ```
  objectstack generate types [config] -o src/types/objectstack.d.ts
  ```
- **`llms.txt` updated** — Full schema inventory (171 schemas, 14 domains, 19 packages)

## Phase 10: Performance & Build

- **Benchmark suite** (`benchmark.bench.ts`) — Vitest bench for all 5 protocol domains + batch validation
- **Bundle size analyzer** (`analyze-bundle-size.ts`) — Reports ESM/CJS/DTS per subpath export; `pnpm analyze` script added
- **Tree-shaking enabled** — `treeshake: true` in tsup config
- **CI gate** — `pnpm analyze` step added to `build-core` job
- **Stale subpath cleanup** — Removed 4 dead exports (`hub`, `auth`, `driver`, `permission`) → 12 valid subpaths

## Phase 11: Security & Compliance

- **SBOM** (`generate-sbom.ts`) — CycloneDX 1.4 output, 63 components
- **License audit** — All deps validated against allowlist (MIT, Apache-2.0, ISC, BSD)
- **Compliance review** — GDPR (6 data subject rights, 6 legal bases), SOC2 (40+ audit event types, immutable logs), HIPAA, PCI-DSS schemas confirmed comprehensive

## Housekeeping

- ROADMAP.md updated to reflect all phases complete
- `.gitignore` updated for generated artifacts (`bundle-size-report.json`, `sbom.json`)
- 191 test files, 5,157 tests — all passing, zero CodeQL alerts
